summary: Injured man with a knee injury about a half mile up the Zapata Trail, inaccessible by EMS; AVSAR mobilized a four-wheeler team to bring him down, but the ambulance crew retrieved him and carried him to the waiting ambulance; AVSAR stood down at 8:49 p.m.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR, Alamosa County Sheriff's Office
notes: Run 1001 insert; AVSAR mission-log entry (date 2015-09-06, Sunday-verified). AVSAR mobilized a four-wheeler team; ambulance crew retrieved the subject first; AVSAR stood down 20:49.
